summary: Backend testing of the new `rencontres_ultime` (29,99€) post-payment pipeline: PDF generation (ReportLab 15 pages) + orchestrator + email + serving + idempotence + checkout persistence. Also ran full regression on plume-chat + CORS suites. 9/9 new tests PASS + 23/23 regression tests PASS = 32/32 total. All 8 review points validated.

minor.issue: SENDER_EMAIL in .env is `Plume Astrale <onboarding@resend.dev>` (Resend sandbox), so email to real customer addresses gets 403 — service catches exception and continues (as documented by main agent). Not a bug, but needs domain verification (plume-astrale.fr) before prod.

action_items: Optional: verify Resend domain plume-astrale.fr in production before launching the pack (SENDER_EMAIL currently uses onboarding@resend.dev sandbox).

Optional: consider persisting _REVEAL_CACHE (in-memory dict in routes/rencontres.py) in Redis/Supabase — currently a backend restart between /reveal and /checkout wipes pdf_ctx source. Checkout still persists pdf_ctx into payment_transactions.metadata so post-restart pipeline works, but restart between reveal→checkout would lose data.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: /app/backend/services/rencontres_ultime_pdf.py generates a real 15-page PDF (verified via pypdf: len(reader.pages) == 15). Magic bytes %PDF- present, ~35-40KB output. Uses FreeSerif for Unicode zodiac glyphs with Helvetica fallback.
GOOD: /app/backend/services/rencontres_ultime_service.py implements idempotence correctly by checking `md.get('pdf_path')` before re-generating — verified: 2nd call preserves pdf_generated_at.
GOOD: Webhook branch in server.py:518-525 correctly routes metadata.kind='rencontres_ultime' to handle_rencontres_ultime_webhook, matching the same pattern as synastrie_oneshot.

GOOD: /api/rencontres/checkout properly extracts pdf_ctx (first_name, birth_date_iso, m7_sign, venus_sign, mars_sign) from _REVEAL_CACHE and persists into payment_transactions.metadata — verified by inserting and reading back.
GOOD: PDF served via /api/assets/rencontres_ultime/<filename>.pdf with content-type application/pdf (200 OK). StaticFiles mount at server.py:1287.
GOOD: Robust fallbacks in generate_rencontres_ultime_pdf — empty strings for all fields still produce a valid PDF (defaults to 'Ami(e)' / 'Balance' / Poissons).
MINOR: rencontres_ultime_service.py:70 uses `session_id[-16:]` for filename — safe but may collide if 2 different Stripe test session_ids share the last 16 chars (rare in practice).
MINOR: routes/rencontres.py:583 sets both `product` and `kind` to 'rencontres_ultime' in Stripe metadata — dual key OK but redundant. Webhook only reads `kind`.
test_credentials: None. Anonymous flow. Seeded a TEST_ prefixed session_id in Supabase payment_transactions, cleaned up after test.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 1 test tx (session_id `cs_test_TEST_ultime_<uuid>`) in Supabase payment_transactions with metadata.kind='rencontres_ultime' + pdf_ctx populated. Cleaned up in fixture teardown. Also ran a real /api/rencontres/checkout call which created a Stripe session + payment_transactions row (deleted after assert).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 36 fully validates the rencontres_ultime pipeline (29,99€ pack). Reusable regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration36_rencontres_ultime.py -v` (~13s, 9 tests, requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + Supabase + Stripe test keys already in .env). Combined regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration34_plume_chat_solena.py /app/backend/tests/test_iteration35_cors_smoke.py /app/backend/tests/test_iteration36_rencontres_ultime.py -v` (~52s, 32 tests, 100% pass). No blocker for main agent.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defect. All 8 review points validated: (1) handle_rencontres_ultime_webhook generates PDF in /app/backend/assets/rencontres_ultime/, (2) idempotence works (pdf_generated_at preserved on 2nd call), (3) PDF has 15 pages via pypdf, (4) generate_rencontres_ultime_pdf produces %PDF- magic bytes, (5) server.py webhook branch routes correctly on metadata.kind, (6) /api/rencontres/checkout persists metadata.kind + metadata.pdf_ctx, (7) /api/assets/rencontres_ultime/*.pdf serves 200 + application/pdf, (8) /api/plume-chat regression unchanged.
